summary: Phase 7D-1 Owner Billing card frontend E2E verified. Owner sees read-only Billing card with seeded $850 open invoice (due Jun 30, 2026); owner isolation confirmed via API (owner sees 1 invoice with matching owner_id, admin sees 195 invoices across 75 owners in same barn); admin does NOT see the owner Billing card on /owner-portal. critical_code_review_comments: OwnerBillingCard.jsx: balance computation uses status !== 'paid' to determine 'open' invoices; treats 'draft', 'void', or any future non-paid status as open balance. Consider explicit allow-list (e.g., ['open','overdue']) for stricter semantics if backend introduces more statuses.
OwnerBillingCard.jsx next-due sort uses lexical sort on due_date strings — works for ISO YYYY-MM-DD but will break silently if backend ever returns non-ISO formats.

Admin /api/invoices currently returns 195 invoices with 75 unique owner_ids in the 'primary' barn — many are leftover TEST_owner_* from prior backend test runs. Test data cleanup (TEST_ prefix teardown) appears to be incomplete in prior backend test suites. Not blocking 7D-1 but worth a cleanup script.
